training.label_source: Library chemistry, not a model. ldx01-05 chemical ligation only, which joins the adapter to the amino acid's alpha-amine and so cannot happen on a deacylated molecule; ldx11-16 enzymatic ligation only, which needs a free 3'-OH a charged tRNA lacks. Reads are assigned to blocks by an LDX barcode call (barcode_crf_nbc16_rna004@v0.3.0), and that caller's error is the only label noise: ~9.3% of the ldx01-05 label is foreign by the 5' marker, against ~0.2% for ldx11-16.
training.dataset: 20260814_charged_vs_uncharged: E. coli K-12 MG1655 tRNA, 16 LDX codes on a single shared edx07 3' adapter, the same pool on two flowcells (Rep_1 PBK76952 train, Rep_2 PBK76980 test).
training.pipeline: dorado 1.4.0 rna004_130bps_sup@v5.3.0 --emit-moves; escpod demux detect --method cnn -> demux basecall --barcodes for the block; bwa mem vs eschColi_K_12_MG1655-edx07.fa; junction windows via move-table mapping; per-base features (mean + z-scored k-mer residual) over offsets -8..+24; matched split; recurrent net over the offset axis; ONNX.

io_contract: input float32 [B,4,33]: channels (mean, resid, mean_observed, resid_observed) over offsets -8..+24, per-channel standardised with the mu/sd fitted on the train split; output [B,2] logits (uncharged, charged).

Reads are assigned to blocks by an LDX barcode call (barcode_crf_nbc16_rna004@v0.3.0), and that caller's error is the only label noise: ~9.3% of the ldx01-05 label is foreign by the 5' marker, against ~0.2% for ldx11-16.
metrics.split: held-out flowcell; training draw matched within (run x isotype x speed bin) across the two chemically pure blocks

standardisation.method: per-channel affine over the TRAIN split's observed values

geometry.anchor: alignment junction (adapter-G base start), per-base features

metrics.coverage_note: Reads whose common arm did not align (cs_source == junction_fallback) are excluded here and abstained on at inference: their whole left window is masked and every arm feature is NaN, and a model scored on them answers ~100% charged whatever the library. The exclusion rate is far higher for charged reads, so any charging fraction derived from called reads alone is an UNDERESTIMATE. Report the no-call rate beside it.
metrics.note: Labels are library chemistry: chemical ligation attaches the adapter to the amino acid's alpha-amine and cannot happen on a deacylated molecule, enzymatic ligation needs a free 3'-OH a charged tRNA lacks. The training draw is matched on isotype and translocation speed because the two blocks also differ in 5' adapter and run ~53% apart. Test is a held-out flowcell.
